method: Weigh the individual pizza base before cooking, using the raw weight listed in the ingredients. Preheat the oven to the temperature stated on its packet. Put a baking tray inside to heat. Keep the base ready on a board; follow any packet instruction to pre-bake it, and use its stated baking time for the final oven stage.
Slice the mixed peppers thinly. Heat half of the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and cook the peppers for 5–6 minutes until softened; transfer them to a clean bowl.
Mix the measured light mayonnaise and wholegrain mustard in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling and refrigerated until assembly.
Drain the firm tofu, pat it dry and cut it into 2cm cubes. Coat with all the measured black pepper. Use clean utensils for the cooked tofu.

Add the remaining half of the measured olive oil to the non-stick frying pan. Cook the tofu cubes over a medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, turning so several faces become golden and the centre is hot. Follow any longer cooking instruction on the tofu pack.

Transfer the browned tofu cubes to the bowl of peppers. Add the measured tomato passata to the empty frying pan and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened so it will not soak the base.

Spread all the thickened tomato passata over the individual pizza base, leaving a narrow border. Arrange the cooked peppers and the browned tofu cubes evenly on top. Carefully slide onto the hot tray.

Bake for the pizza base packet's stated time, until the dough is cooked through, the base is crisp underneath and the topping is hot throughout. Spoon over the cold finishing sauce after the pizza comes out of the oven. Rest for one minute, cut and serve.
